name: How long does an accessibility kitchen remodel usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an accessibility kitchen remodel usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an accessibility kitchen remodel depends on its complexity. A basic remodel involving lower countertops, pull-out shelves, and accessible sink placement might take 2-4 weeks. More comprehensive projects, which could include reconfiguring the layout, installing custom cabinetry, or moving plumbing/electrical lines, can extend to 6-10 weeks or more. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: An accessibility kitchen remodel typically takes 2-10 weeks, depending on the project's complexity and scope of changes.
